watched #Majnu ……. a Simple Story with Simple Screenplay wrapped with Simple Music and Simple Comedy!!!! cinema motham ekada gudaa WOW factor undadhu alla anni VAMMOO factor guda undadhu!!! akadakada drag ayinatu untundi but watchable

last 2 mnths nunchi vachinaaa different genere and routinue ooraa mass genere kakunda simple routine story medha kevalam Nani performance n Raj Tarun cameo ni pwtubadi ga peti tesina cinemaa…..if you watch with No expectations you will like it, but ee madhya Nani cinemalaga oo adbuthallu expect chesthe mathram may get dissapointed

Cinema motham oka ethu…last 10 mins oka ethu!!! All that ends good is good ane concept bati chusthe cinema is Timepassable…

to conclude Nani is the Sole and Solo of this Film with a small but effective support from Raj Tarun
